# Repository names

- Write the name of a zencq repository in lowercase, whatever case GitHub shows: `zencq/example`, `https://github.com/zencq/example`. This holds for code, tests, workflows, configuration and documentation alike.
- Only a test that checks how names in other cases are handled uses another case, on purpose.
